name: HELM
focus: Broad scenario and metric coverage for foundation models.
evidence: Public framework, prompts/responses inspection and leaderboards.
palo_difference: PALO proposes a narrower procurement specification-fidelity study. Multi-dimensional evaluation is established prior art.
lesson: Retain scenario, adapter, model and metric versions.
source_status: README reports maintenance mode since June 2026.

name: BIG-bench
focus: Collaborative tasks probing diverse language-model capabilities.
evidence: Public tasks, evaluation code and published experiments.
palo_difference: PALO targets business-rule preservation in a reviewed specification, rather than broad capability coverage.
lesson: Use explicit task definitions and diverse independently selected cases.
source_status: Repository archived on 17 April 2026; retained as historical prior art.

name: BigBIO
focus: Harmonised biomedical datasets and task schemas.
evidence: Dataloaders, provenance, licensing metadata and dataset documentation.
palo_difference: A dataset library is a reference for corpus governance, not a competing procurement-specification score.
lesson: Document source rights, schema mappings and provenance.

name: BigScience Evaluation
focus: Task-based language-model evaluation, including translation and question answering.
evidence: Code, task abstractions and evaluation instructions.
palo_difference: PALO adds a scoped evidence contract for annotated business propositions; it has not demonstrated broader capability coverage.
lesson: Keep task-specific evaluation separate from model execution.
source_status: README retains 2021 milestones; no current deployment qualification inferred.

name: LM Evaluation Harness
focus: Configurable execution of academic language-model tasks across backends.
evidence: Task configurations, model adapters, metrics and sample logging.
palo_difference: This is reusable execution infrastructure. PALO supplies a proposed domain-specific task and adjudication contract; no integration is claimed.
lesson: Reuse configuration discipline and record prompt, backend and generation settings.

name: Scholar Evals
focus: Scope could not be verified from the referenced repository.
evidence: The referenced repository returned HTTP 404 during this review.
palo_difference: No capability comparison or judgement of benchmark quality is made from an unavailable source.
lesson: Preserve the discovery reference and mark unknown evidence explicitly.
source_status: Unavailable at the referenced URL; reason unknown.

name: BigCode Evaluation Harness
focus: Code generation and related coding tasks, including unit-test-based evaluation.
evidence: Task implementations, generation/evaluation tooling and container instructions.
palo_difference: Correct code against supplied tests does not establish that the originating business requirement was interpreted faithfully.
lesson: Keep code-test outcomes separate from source-rule fidelity.

name: Chatbot Arena / Arena
focus: Model comparison with uncertainty-aware score and rank presentation.
evidence: Published ranking methodology and confidence/rank intervals.
palo_difference: PALO proposes source-based adjudication of obligations and exceptions; preference and semantic fidelity answer different questions.
lesson: Show uncertainty and avoid treating a small numerical ordering as a stable ranking.
source_status: Current methodology checked; directory points to historical FastChat infrastructure.

name: GLUE
focus: General natural-language understanding across multiple tasks.
evidence: Task suite, analysis platform and published methodology.
palo_difference: PALO examines source-to-specification transformations and the correction burden within a business domain.
lesson: Use task-specific gold and publish per-task results.
source_status: The directory links jiant, an implementation toolkit whose README says it is no longer actively maintained.

name: SuperGLUE
focus: More challenging general language-understanding tasks following GLUE.
evidence: Benchmark tasks, evaluation methodology and analysis resources.
palo_difference: PALO is narrower and currently unqualified; neither general NLU performance nor PALO diagnostics imply success on the other.
lesson: Define acceptance and task difficulty before comparing systems.
source_status: Distinguish the benchmark from the jiant implementation linked by the directory.

name: CLUE
focus: Chinese-language understanding through representative classification and reading tasks.
evidence: Datasets, baselines, task metrics and leaderboards.
palo_difference: PALO has not qualified multilingual specification fidelity. Country of model origin is not a language-quality measurement.
lesson: Treat language and localisation as explicit evaluation conditions.

name: CodeXGLUE
focus: Code understanding and generation, including code/text transformations.
evidence: Task datasets, baselines and evaluation resources.
palo_difference: PALO proposes checking the business meaning before code is produced; code/text overlap is acknowledged.
lesson: Separate transformation types and use outcome-appropriate metrics.

name: Vals AI
focus: Industry-oriented tasks and model comparisons across professional domains.
evidence: Published benchmark pages and methodologies; some benchmarks are proprietary.
palo_difference: Enterprise evaluation is already established. PALO proposes a specific document-to-specification fidelity study, without claiming broader coverage or superior validation.
lesson: Use realistic tasks and make public/private evidence boundaries explicit.

name: Artificial Analysis
focus: Quality, intelligence, performance and price of models, endpoints and systems.
evidence: Published measurement definitions and comparative results.
palo_difference: PALO records configuration-specific evidence and proposes workflow correction effort; current cost records are not full enterprise cost measurements.
lesson: Distinguish model, serving endpoint and complete system.

name: OfficeQA
focus: Complex questions over real-world financial documents.
evidence: Evaluation code and corpus tooling; source documents, parsed data and gated answer sets are documented.
palo_difference: A close comparator. PALO proposes evaluating the resulting specification and altered rules, rather than only answers to questions.
lesson: Separate parsing, retrieval and reasoning; keep unseen document families.

name: DABstep
focus: Multi-step business data analysis with factoid answers.
evidence: Tasks, answer-format requirements and automated answer checks.
palo_difference: PALO propositions can admit multiple legitimate formulations and require semantic adjudication; answer normalisation alone is insufficient.
lesson: Use deterministic checks where valid, without confusing formatting with correctness.

name: OmniDocBench
focus: Document parsing, including text, tables, formulas and layout.
evidence: Annotated document data and evaluation tooling.
palo_difference: Parsing is an upstream component; PALO proposes checking whether extracted content retains its business meaning in a specification.
lesson: Measure extraction independently from interpretation.

name: SWE-bench Verified
focus: Resolution of repository issues using a human-validated task subset.
evidence: Task definitions, evaluation resources and published agent results.
palo_difference: PALO focuses on interpreting the source requirement before implementation; passing software tests addresses a different evaluation stage.
lesson: Freeze the harness and distinguish model comparisons from whole-agent comparisons.

name: FACTS Grounding
focus: Factual grounding of generated responses in supplied documents.
evidence: Published benchmark and multi-judge evaluation methodology.
palo_difference: A close semantic comparator. PALO proposes domain-specific critical-rule inversions and human repair effort; that additional value still needs validation.
lesson: Calibrate semantic judging against independent reference decisions.

name: Andon Labs Blueprint-Bench 2
focus: Reconstruction of apartment floor plans from photographs.
evidence: Published task description, connectivity metric and leaderboard.
palo_difference: Distinct project and meaning of blueprint: spatial floor plans versus business development specifications. No affiliation or shared score.
lesson: Disambiguate the name and compare only commensurate tasks.
